title: Incidence Axioms
summary: Incidence axioms specify the basic relationships between points and lines in a plane.
statements: For any two distinct points A and B, there is exactly one line containing both A and B.
Every line contains at least two distinct points.
There exist at least three noncollinear points.
whatItEnables: You can refer unambiguously to the line through two distinct points and prove that two distinct lines have at most one common point.
